UI (Playwright 1920x1080): landing $200 -> $1,000.00 and packages $50..$1,000 at 5X with no ₹; deposit dialog USDT TRC20 instructions, ERC20/BEP20 show payment-unavailable with submit disabled, ref <6 chars disables submit, UPI tab shows 'Pay ₹9,500 by UPI' + fx rate, submit works with toast; admin Deposits shows method/network, payment ref, Received (₹9,500 @ ₹95/$ or 250 USDT), USD amount, credits, and approve/reject work; Credit Config FX edit INR 90 + add EUR saved (UPI/TRC20 untouched), EUR 0 -> error toast, restored INR 95 / EUR removed; Loss Rewards preview lists demo $80 -> $4, confirm dialog, toast, run listed, button disabled afterwards; Users has Referral income + Loss rewards columns ($15/$4); Referrals page shows EARNING $15; Money Flow shows all live totals (verified against DB math) + admin access card; player Refer page shows earning; Rewards page shows $4 total + history; Games lobby shows Evolution/Ezugi/Pragmatic as Coming soon; Statement CSV exports USD columns; provider rotate-key confirm (dismiss = no rotate, accept = new key dialog); fraud list; logout + protected-route redirect. No ₹ found in player/admin money UI except the UPI INR amounts. No page errors, no backend 500s.

minor.issue: SettingsIn gives fx_rates/upi_id/usdt_* defaults ({} / ''). A body that leaves these out silently wipes all FX rates and payment addresses, which turns off UPI and USDT deposits. The UI sends the full object, so only API clients are affected. Make these fields required or merge them with the stored values.

The overlap check and the insert are not atomic. Two Pay clicks or requests at the same moment can both pass and pay the same period twice. The run doc is also inserted before the credit loop, so a failure mid-loop leaves a partial payout that can't be retried. Use a lock or unique guard (e.g. a conditional upsert on a 'loss_reward_lock' doc), or insert the run with status=processing and mark it done after the loop.

The duplicate payment_reference check is a find-then-insert with no unique index, so two concurrent submits with the same UTR/TX hash both succeed. It is also case-sensitive ('abc123' and 'ABC123' are treated as different references).
The email provider hit its rate limit (429) during test registrations. This was handled gracefully (verification_sent=false), but users won't get a verification email while the limit lasts.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Coming soon' providers still have an enabled Play button. Each click creates a new game session and shows a 'being connected' toast. Consider disabling it or labelling it 'Notify me' when connected=false.

issues: The payment reference input relies on its placeholder. Once the user types, there is no visible label saying what the field is (UTR / TX hash). Add a label.
fx-row/fx-rate/fx-code data-testids are derived from the code being typed, so the testid changes on every keystroke. Use the index or a stable id.

Add a unique (case-normalised) index or atomic guard for active payment_reference
